note: Live Shopify Admin analytics snapshot. The Vercel runtime has no Shopify Admin credentials, so this file is refreshed out-of-band (via the connected Shopify MCP) and read by the website-designs CRO layer. US store only (the connected store); connect the UK/Global stores for regional numbers.

design_justifications.decision: Above-the-fold hero: single clear value promise + one primary CTA (Z-pattern), no competing links
design_justifications.why: Only 947 of 50,499 sessions convert; a diffuse above-the-fold is the first leak.
design_justifications.how: One promise, one CTA, trust proof in view within 1.5s reduces bounce and lifts session-to-order.

design_justifications.decision: Product grid: contain-fit imagery, visible price + category filter, fast first paint
design_justifications.why: Only 2,263 of 50,499 sessions add to cart — discovery/consideration is the biggest drop-off.
design_justifications.how: Scannable cards, price up front and category filtering shorten time-to-product and raise cart adds.

design_justifications.decision: PDP: facts grid (paint, design notes, format, pairs), reviews, sticky Add-to-cart CTA
design_justifications.why: 4,138 reach checkout but only 947 complete — friction/uncertainty at decision time.
design_justifications.how: Answering objections on the PDP (facts + proof) and a persistent CTA carry more reachers to purchase.

design_justifications.decision: Bundles + free-shipping threshold set just above current AOV
design_justifications.why: Raising basket size compounds revenue at the same traffic and conversion.
design_justifications.how: A threshold ~10-15% above AOV plus curated bundles nudges add-on units.

design_justifications.decision: Subscription / replenishment anchor + post-purchase second-order nudge
design_justifications.why: The returning base is already the volume driver; protecting and deepening it defends revenue.
design_justifications.how: Subscribe-and-save on the PDP and replenishment timing lift repeat order rate and LTV.
